home.heroSubtitle: Vis gives salons, clinics, studios and trainers a booking page, a shared calendar, and everything needed to manage appointments — built for Georgia.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to take bookings

booking.title: Your booking page
booking.desc: A booking page clients can use around the clock, from a link you share in your Instagram bio.

staff.title: Staff & calendar
staff.desc: Assign services to staff, manage a shared calendar, and approve, reschedule or cancel bookings.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.desc: Weekly hours, per-day overrides and breaks — available slots stay accurate on their own.

reviews.title: Verified reviews
reviews.desc: Collect a review after each completed appointment and show your rating on your booking page.

widget.title: Embeddable widget
widget.desc: Drop your booking form straight into your existing website with a single snippet.

api.title: Public REST API
api.desc: Connect Vis to your own site or tools with a REST API and per-business keys.
